android.desc:
Browse fast, stay secure and do more with Opera Mini. Access your favorite apps through Speed Dial, save data, block ads, check football scores, chat with AI, and download files - all in one fast and private browser.

 Popular Opera Mini Features:
✔️ Fast, lite browser for smooth browsing
✔️ Free data – available for select markets
✔️ Adblock for faster and cleaner browsing
✔️ Private browsing & incognito mode
✔️ AI chat built into your browser
✔️ Locked mode with PIN protection
✔️ Night theme for comfortable browsing in the dark
✔️ Football scores and updates 
✔️ News tailored to your interests
✔️ Fast downloads & offline pages

 🚀 Browse Faster with Ad blocker
Opera Mini is a fast web browser! Opera Mini reduces your page loading times, even on slow networks. Block ads with built-in Adblock, for the smoothest browsing experience.

🔒 Private Browsing
Stay in control of your privacy. Open private tabs in Incognito mode to browse the web without saving history, cookies, or temporary files on your device. 

🔑 Locked Mode and Private Downloads
Add an extra layer of security to your browsing. Secure your private tabs with a unique PIN. Download files in a private folder, so only you can access them.

🤖 AI Chat in Your Browser
Ask questions, get quick answers, or explore ideas directly from your browser with free built-in AI chat. No extra apps needed.

⚽ Football Scores & News
Follow live football scores, match updates, and news from your favourite leagues and teams directly inside Opera Mini.

📲 MiniPay
Send and spend wherever you want with MiniPay, a wallet in your browser. Get up to $0.30 when you join and earn up to $1 in daily rewards.

🌙 Night Theme
Browse comfortably at night with Night Theme, which dims your screen and reduces eye strain when reading in the dark.

🏆 Opera Rewards
Get rewarded for browsing. With Opera Rewards, you can collect daily points simply by using Opera Mini and redeem them for rewards inside the app.

📥 Downloads & Offline Pages
Download videos, files, and webpages quickly and access them anytime. Save pages to read offline without needing an internet connection.

Additional features:
✔️ Video player
✔️ Personalized newsfeed
✔️ Browser customization and themes

By downloading this application, you agree to the End User Licence Agreement at https://www.opera.com/eula/mobile.
Learn how Opera handles and protects your data in our Privacy Statement at https://www.opera.com/privacy.
